name: team-contribution-process
description: Standard Git workflow that every team member must follow to avoid conflicts

rule0.title: Protected Branches
rules: Do not push directly to main
Do not push directly to dev
All work must happen in feature/* or fix/* branches

step1.title: Pull Latest Code
step1.description: Always update local dev branch before starting work

step2.title: Create Feature Branch
step2.description: Create a new branch from dev for your task

step3.title: Work On Assigned Files Only
step3.description: Work only on files related to your assigned feature. Inform team before modifying shared files.

step4.title: Commit Properly
step4.commandExample: git commit -m "feat: added order creation API"

step5.title: Push Feature Branch
step5.description: Push your branch to remote repository

step6.title: Create Pull Request
step6.description: Open PR from feature branch to dev branch

step7.title: Code Review Before Merge
step7.description: At least one teammate must review and approve before merging into dev

step8.title: Test After Merge
step8.description: After merging, pull latest dev and test the application locally
